The agent from IndiaMART called the lead regarding buyleads. The agent proposed a meeting with a sales executive. The lead initially stated unavailability for tomorrow but agreed to a meeting the day after tomorrow at 3 PM. The lead confirmed Maheshtala as the preferred meeting location.
